node.title: Re: package variable does not persist
node.author: AnomalousMonk
node.doctext:
As a start on an [id://1177642|SSCCE], I wonder if something like this might be happening: # Module.pm package Module; use warnings; use strict; use vars qw($configvar); sub what_is_configvar { if ($Module::configvar) { return 'true'; } else { return 'false'; } } sub menu { print 'in menu(): ', what_is_configvar(); } sub inModule { print 'in Module: ', what_is_configvar(); } inModule(); 1; And then: c:\@Work\Perl\monks\Anonymous Monk\1221498>perl -le "use warnings; use strict; ;; use Module; ;; $Module::configvar = 1; ;; Module::menu(); " in Module: false in menu(): true

Give a man a fish: <%-{-{-{-<
